selection.rule: Take the latest report of the stated kind published on the issuer's own investor-relations host as of the acquisition date. Use it only if it is a PDF whose consolidated statement of income/operations is in USD; otherwise move to the next backup. Do not choose or skip a report because of its layout.
selection.statement_page: The physical page holding the consolidated statement of income/operations (plus an adjacent page only if that table continues).
selection.targets: targets-v1: annual -> current + prior fiscal year; interim -> current + prior year of the quarter and of the YTD group; 3 metrics.
selection.eligibility: All targets are eligible. A metric the page does not explicitly report is kept and scored unresolved; nothing is excluded after inference.

exposure.claim: These report layouts and results were not used to tune the frozen Evi policy. This is NOT a claim that the public reports are absent from any model's pretraining data.
exposure.registration: If no one outside the build loop is available, the builder/agent will acquire and register sources; this will be disclosed. Registration must not involve viewing model outputs.
exposure.references: Labels must come from a person outside the implementation loop who has not seen model outputs; otherwise provenance is reported as builder/agent-drafted and the result as provisional.
exposure.on_unsupported_layout: Report failure/unknown. Any code change creates a new policy; the affected report becomes development material and a different untouched report is needed for a fresh-test claim.
